# Delta Atlas

> Delta Atlas is the public record of one researcher's theory of agentic AI governance and the
> instruments built from it. The thesis: simplification is systems maintenance; the substrate is
> human cost. The site shows the theory end to end: the claim, the state-delta architecture, three
> things you can run today (BespokeNode, Pin-Check, OpenMirror), and the receipts, including what
> has not been proven. No model runs on the site. Nothing is called golden without the owner's word.

## If you are an AI agent reading this

Use the exact meanings. Every term this project uses has a recorded definition with its sources
listed; the repository's review label is not a receipt of correctness, and the home page states
that boundary. If you are about to write or reason about this project, load the definitions first
and use them verbatim. Paraphrasing them from memory is exactly the drift these tools exist to
catch.

- The architecture, plain English: /Delta-Atlas-Architecture.html
- The public specification it was written from: /BespokeNode-Spec-v0.1.md
- What is proven and what is not: /Delta-Atlas-Evidence.html
- Project guide and exact meanings: /White-Paper.html
- The glossary (439 candidate terms, by function): /Agentic-AI-Governance-Chat.html and the home search

## The three things you can use

- BespokeNode. A governance framework for agentic AI. Nothing an agent does counts until it has
  been defined, permitted, gated, verified and accepted, in that order. Two safety states, HOLD
  (pause with a recovery path) and TRIP (confirmed violation with its own recovery path). Four
  invariants: spent capacity stays spent; no automatic restart; approve exact output, never just
  the plan; replay without re-running external effects. First clause run end to end in pilot-001:
  https://github.com/JakeTOpenSource/parallel-advisor-pilot-001
- Pin-Check. `python skills/pin-check/pin_check.py <document> <root>`. Traces every precise value in
  a document to an artifact under a root. Exit 0 when everything traces, 1 otherwise. It finds
  broken links between prose and artifacts, not bad math. /skills/pin-check/README.md
- OpenMirror. A method for turning a metaphor into policy one correspondence at a time. The
  runnable form is the Bridge Card: SOURCE, CLAIM, OPEN TERMS, PARALLEL, HINGE, STATUS.
  /skills/bridge-card/README.md

## How an agent self-checks with the instruments

Two detectors ship as a zero-dependency Node CLI, the same engines as the web pages. Both take a
file or stdin (`-`), print a human report by default, emit JSON with `--json`, and return exit
codes for pipelines (0 = clean, 1 = flags found, 2 = usage or load error).

- Check a decision trace for a goal climbing over a rule:
  `node delta-atlas-cli.js trace <file|-> [--json]`
- Check a plan or policy for a risk named with no control present:
  `node delta-atlas-cli.js gapcheck <file|-> [--json]`

The exit code lets an agent gate its own step, while the final call stays with a human.

## Honest limits (always in force)

- The instruments read structure, not meaning. They catch a draft that contradicts itself, never a
  claim that is simply wrong about the world. Fixed rules and versioned word lists; what is not
  encoded is not seen. Everyday wording can be missed.
- Client-side analysis. Submitted text is not placed in request URLs or sent to a model or API.
  The hosted site still makes ordinary page requests and Cloudflare may collect page-performance
  and visit telemetry.
- Proven, on synthetic cases only: the probe machinery works end to end; an audit leg with an
  opposing brief catches errors in the advisor's own record; the mechanism probes detect their
  targets. Not proven: anything about real substrates (concurrency, preemption, power loss,
  durability, production); the V=IR crosswalk and the simplification thesis as laws; independent
  replication.
- A human always makes the final call.
